definitions.explanation: Of a change in degree that happens fast: {急|きゅう}に{寒|さむ}くなる (it gets cold all of a sudden).

examples.japanese: {急|きゅう}に⟦{雨|あめ}→雨：00583_ame⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{降|ふ}り{出|だ}した→降り出す：03004_furidasu⟧。
{急|きゅう}に⟦{予定|よてい}→予定：00824_yotei⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{変|か}わった→変わる：00714_kawaru⟧。
{急|きゅう}に⟦{走|はし}る→走る：00519_hashiru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{危|あぶ}ない→危ない：00768_abunai⟧⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧⟦よ→よ：09475_yo⟧。
examples.english: It's dangerous if you run suddenly.

examples.japanese: ⟦{車|くるま}→車：00516_kuruma⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{急|きゅう}に⟦{止|と}まった→止まる：00555_tomaru⟧。
{急|きゅう}に⟦{熱|ねつ}→熱：01690_netsu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{出|で}て→出る：00513_deru⟧、⟦{学校|がっこう}→学校：00055_gakkou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{休|やす}んだ→休む：00606_yasumu⟧。
examples.english: I suddenly got a fever and stayed home from school.

examples.japanese: {急|きゅう}に⟦{行|い}けなく→行く：00119_iku⟧⟦なった→なる：01970_naru⟧。
{急|きゅう}に⟦{仕事|しごと}→仕事：00480_shigoto⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{頼|たの}まれた→頼む：01104_tanomu⟧。
examples.english: I was suddenly asked to do a job.

examples.japanese: {急|きゅう}に⟦{準備|じゅんび}する→準備する：22427_junbisuru⟧⟦{必要|ひつよう}→必要：00846_hitsuyou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{出|で}てきた→出てくる：29121_detekuru⟧。
examples.english: Suddenly we needed to get ready.

examples.japanese: ⟦{夕方|ゆうがた}→夕方：01010_yuugata⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧{急|きゅう}に⟦{気温|きおん}→気温：00235_kion⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{下|さ}がった→下がる：01188_sagaru⟧。
examples.english: The temperature dropped sharply from the evening on.

examples.japanese: ⟦{電車|でんしゃ}→電車：00522_densha⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{乗|の}り→乗る：00511_noru⟧⟦{遅|おく}れ→遅れる：00741_okureru⟧そうだ⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{気|き}づいて、{急|きゅう}に⟦{走|はし}り{出|だ}した→走り出す：06679_hashiridasu⟧。
examples.english: Realizing I might miss the train, I suddenly broke into a run.

notes:
{急|きゅう}に is an adverb formed from the na-adjective ⟦{急|きゅう}→急：13042_kyuu⟧ (sudden, urgent).

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {急|きゅう}に⟦{止|と}まる→止まる：00555_tomaru⟧ (to stop suddenly)
- {急|きゅう}に⟦{変|か}わる→変わる：00714_kawaru⟧ (to change suddenly)
- {急|きゅう}に⟦{始|はじ}まる→始まる：00841_hajimaru⟧ (to start suddenly)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {急|きゅう}に vs. ⟦{突然|とつぜん}→突然：00409_totsuzen⟧: Both mean "suddenly," but ⟦{突然|とつぜん}→突然：00409_totsuzen⟧ emphasizes unexpectedness more strongly, while {急|きゅう}に can also describe a sharp change in degree ({急|きゅう}に⟦{寒|さむ}く→寒い：00664_samui⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧); for doing something in a hurry, use ⟦{急|いそ}いで→急ぐ：01191_isogu⟧.
- {急|きゅう}に vs. ⟦いきなり→いきなり：09379_ikinari⟧: ⟦いきなり→いきなり：09379_ikinari⟧ implies doing something without warning or preamble, often with a nuance of rudeness.

NOTE: {急|きゅう}に describes sudden events and abrupt changes. It does not mean "hurriedly"; that is ⟦{急|いそ}いで→急ぐ：01191_isogu⟧.

cross_references.label: suddenly, abruptly, out of the blue
